source_datasets.citation: KOSIS table DT_1IN9506, 행정구역/성/연령별 종교인구, 1995 Population Census.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Raw KOSIS mass CSV ZIP is not committed; derived public products attribute KOSIS.
source_datasets.notes: Used for 1995 current-sido rows. The table includes province/metropolitan rows and sub-provincial rows; Ulsan-si is split from the printed Gyeongsangnam-do total, and Sejong is null because it did not exist in 1995. The denominator is 계, and 미상 (unknown) remains in the denominator. Printed 1995 categories map as follows: 불교, 개신교, 천주교, 유교, 원불교, 천도교, 대종교, 대순진리회, and 기타 all contribute to religious_affiliation_count; 기타 is the residual other category; 종교없음 maps to no_religion_count.

indicators.label: Religion table denominator
indicators.description: People in the KOSIS religion table denominator for the area and census year.
indicators.method: 1995: KOSIS DT_1IN9506 계. 2005: KOSIS DT_1IN0505 내국인 (명). 2015: KOSIS DT_1PM1502 계, from the 20% sample survey of the register-based census.
indicators.spatial_coverage: South Korea current sido reporting units harmonised to a 2018 KoStat-derived boundary layer.
indicators.quality_notes: 1995 and 2005 keep 미상 (unknown) in the denominator. 2015 rows are sample_survey_20pct.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the table denominator in named religion categories.
indicators.method: 100 * sum(named religion categories) / table total. The 1995 기타 column maps to the existing other/residual component inside religious affiliation.
indicators.spatial_coverage: South Korea current sido reporting units harmonised to a 2018 KoStat-derived boundary layer.
indicators.quality_notes: The broad any-religion construct is retained; no denomination crosswalk is attempted.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the table denominator in the KOSIS no-religion category.
indicators.spatial_coverage: South Korea current sido reporting units harmonised to a 2018 KoStat-derived boundary layer.
indicators.quality_notes: No religion is 종교없음 in 1995, 종교없음 (명) in 2005, and 종교없음-계 in 2015.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: South Korea census religious-affiliation share by current sido.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: reported, explicitly aggregated, or explicitly subtracted KOSIS area value
visual_layers.notes: 1995 Ulsan is split from Gyeongsangnam-do; 2015 values are 20% sample-survey estimates from the register-based census.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: South Korea census no-religion share by current sido.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: reported, explicitly aggregated, or explicitly subtracted KOSIS area value
visual_layers.notes: 1995 and 2005 keep the source unknown category in the denominator.
